hypotheses.name: Support-margin two-axis filtration topology screen
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 on source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}, computed a two-axis filtration surrogate over Euclidean distance and directed-support margin, then tested two-axis edge connectivity summaries against a directed baseline and a one-axis ablation with margin-shuffle, support-shuffle, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=-0.03184; lung/source=-0.02633; external_lung/source=-0.02928; positive mean domain-splits 0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this AUROC-lift form of the two-axis filtration branch; only reopen with a materially different endpoint (e.g., calibration/ranking utility instead of direct AUROC lift).
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Second major-change utility test remained negative in both source-disjoint failure slices and all domain-split means.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model topology codebook transport
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot on immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits at layers {7,11}; learned scGPT/Geneformer topology codebooks and a GF->scGPT transport matrix on two held-in domains, then evaluated held-out-domain edge transfer against GF baseline with random-codebook, token-frequency, and signature-destroy nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean null_gap_q95=+0.13671 (immune mean +0.16157; non-immune positive null-gap 4/4), but mean transfer delta AUROC=-0.10204 with positive mean delta domain-splits 0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire cross-model alignment in this loop after this major-change rescue; only revisit with a new downstream objective that explicitly rewards utility, not null-gap alone.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Major-change rescue produced robust null-gap but uniformly negative transfer-vs-baseline utility across all domain-splits.

hypotheses.name: Intrinsic-dimension interaction-only screen
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung and seeds 42/43/44 on source/target-disjoint splits, tested ID-transition interaction terms (0->3, 3->7, 7->11) with directed support/margin against a directed-geodesic baseline, with interaction-partner shuffle, layer-order permutation, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta AUROC=-0.13176; positive mean domain-splits 0/6; Fisher-significant domain-splits 0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire intrinsic-dimensionality interaction scoring for this loop and shift manifold tests toward non-ID geometric families.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Interaction-only rescue failed globally with large negative deltas and no significant domain-split aggregates.
